Profile
History of Tourism and Travel Management Department:-
The Department of Tourism and Travel Management was established in the year 2012.
It can\'t be denied that there is tremendous potential for tourism in the North Eastern Region of India. Realizing this great emphasis has been laid upon the development of tourism industry in Assam. It can rightly be expected that tourism will create both direct and indirect employment in the Coming years in this part of the country. There will be a great demand for professionally qualified man power to serve this industry. Hence a course in Tourism & Travel has become very relevant in Assam now. Therefore M. N. C Balika Mahavidyalaya affiliated to Gauhati University envisaged the introduction of the subject of TTM.
The Objectives of TTM Department:-
The main objectives of TTM department is to impart basic knowledge & skills of Tourism to students which in turn will help them to get job opportunities or it will atleast offer them opportunities of self employment. The department also intends to create awareness about Tourism & Travel among the masses & to work for promotion of Tourism by holding Tourism awareness programmr, special lecture, seminar, other activities such as Quiz competition etc.
Presently, the subject of TTM of our department is under the Regular Course, Minor Course and Skill Enhancement Course(SEC) of Gauhati University. This new subject seems to have succeeded to attract students since its introduction in 2012. There has been a gradual rise in enrollment in TTM.
